articles.description: https://instagram.com/p/Dc4Ir1_Bo0g On Friday, Lea Salonga became the first Filipina to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. The Broadway legend was the first Asian actor to win a Tony Award, which she earned in 1991 for her role in Miss Saigon . She is also famously the singing voice of Jasmine in Aladdin and the titular character in Mulan . Ming-Na Wen, the voice actor for Mulan, spoke at the ceremony to honour Salonga, as did Brandy and Darren Criss. Source
